ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud in Minnesota and determine how much money was lost to fraudulent activities.
questions: How much money was lost to child care fraud in Minnesota?
Who were the main perpetrators of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale financial scandal and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money, we can determine the extent of the fraud and identify potential patterns of corruption.
